children.text: Hello, and thank you for visiting my site! My name is Courtney and I am a mother of two lovely, beautiful daughters. Early in my life I discovered that I had a passion for photography, and the birth of my daughters deepened that passion. It was a joy to capture their special moments, and it often makes my heart ache to revisit those moments years later. Photography is a craft unlike any other, and it is my goal to share my skill with you and to help capture your family's moments.
